findings.title: Newly observed inherited Phase-3 live-plane test failure needs an owner before the parent retained matrix is rebaselined

findings.impact: Not caused by and not evidence for this slice, but it is an undiagnosed stale expectation (likely the mocked outbox/publication path, same family as the 18 inherited phase-3g mocked-room failures) that could be silently absorbed into 'inherited' debt; the README also records that the driver committed and pushed before reviewing this diagnostic

findings.title: Dormant open-progress source classification must be causal-RED or deleted by parent f5b
findings.evidence: packages/node/src/v3-live.ts:8804-8828 computes openProgressSources only when a SettlementFrontierContext is supplied; the sole production caller at v3-live.ts:8242 calls readSettlementSources(registration) with no frontier, so the branch at v3-live.ts:7054 is unreachable in shipped code
findings.impact: Unexercised production branch beside authenticated frontier logic; parent f5b could thread the frontier onto code that has never failed a test for the reason the design names
findings.required_action: Parent f5b owner: as the first step of authenticated settlement-frontier threading, write a tests-only RED that reaches openProgressSources through the genuine checkpoint-derived frontier, or delete the dormant plumbing in that RED's GREEN; no change in f5b0v

red_green_causality: Causal and exact. RED e8e7b027 (reporter.json, validation.json) selected one test and failed exactly one assertion token NODE_CALLBACK_REJECTION_GUIDANCE_IS_SURFACE_SPECIFIC while room wording, common replay/digest guidance, room signature and Node function-type controls passed; only the test file changed (source-check.json productionChanges 0, v3-live.ts sha dc59309e equal to the c66e09c2 isolated hash). GREEN 3f47ced3 audit.mjs proves the baseline contains the old sentence exactly once and that replacing it with the three-statement set yields the committed file byte-for-byte, with comment-free printed AST and non-JSDoc token streams equal and room source, both tests and pnpm-lock.yaml untouched; current v3-live.ts:381-387 matches. Upstream, 488a22a6 failed exactly the two external-ledger tokens with ten non-failure controls, 4521f03f RED failed the nine operand cases then passed 5/5, and c66e09c2 closed the contract with renamed replayable tokens.
replay_contract_assessment: The corrected Node JSDoc matches the call sites: ordinary authenticated ingress catches the sink and logs sink-rejected then continues (v3-live.ts:4121-4134); local issue catches, logs and returns localIssueSuccess (v3-live.ts:6683-6700); successor-recovery replay catches, awaits handle.deactivate() and returns recovery-rejected (v3-live.ts:8697-8705). The room-owned session callback stays fail closed: commit() awaits onAcceptedVertex before any map/projection update (examples/v3-room/src/index.ts:1918-1934) and the 'fails closed and releases successor custody' cases assert no active owner, transport released and no partial commit. Exact-once is held on canonical projection, application-state bytes and directly read issuance-store lineage/rows (REPLAY_RECOVERY_DURABLE_ISSUANCE_UNCHANGED, REPLAY_RECOVERY_EACH_DURABLE_OPERATION_ONCE), while notification attempts are explicitly observed as [d1] then [d1,d1,d2]. The consumer inventory test pins grid and v3-chat no-ops and four in-memory room collectors; no shipped consumer needs durable exactly-once external effects, so no receipt patch or new port is warranted here.
scope_assessment: Scope preserved. The comment-only GREEN changed no callback shape, export, API, schema, wire, authority, behavior, dependency, threshold, timeout or workload (AST/token equality, unchanged lockfile hash 56e8b9b5). The original candidate ea02487e touched exactly the nine authorized paths (production-identity.json) with the single workspace dependency edge. The inherited retained failures (18 phase-3g mocked-room plus one product unsupported-cold-composition) and the 13 Node typecheck headers are unchanged against the ea02487e normalized baseline. Parent f5b still owns authenticated settlement-frontier threading (readSettlementSources is called with no frontier at v3-live.ts:8242), successful settlement-profile repeated close/adopt, dormant open-progress resolution, hot-successor declaration custody and the one-room 64-writer/every-writer-every-epoch/three-close plus eventual >=100-transition golden-path gates; nothing in f5b0u/f5b0v claims them.
evidence_assessment: All seven roots are present with self-excluding manifests (none lists manifest.sha256) and recorded validation results: ea02487e focused 70/70 local and isolated, chromium-expanded 1 expected/0 unexpected, retained 350 total 331 pass 19 inherited local and isolated, noNewFailure; 4521f03f RED nine exact soft failures then GREEN 5/5; 488a22a6 two exact soft failures; 1a4906a9 empty P0/P1 union across Grok (resumed exact session after NO_VERDICT), Sol and Fable; c66e09c2 focused 6/6, governance 4/4, retained 123 with 104 pass and 19 inherited, typecheck-equivalence against the ea02487e baseline, clean-clone isolation; e8e7b027 and 3f47ced3 as described, with the 33-test retained set spanning six files and Node typecheck showing the same 13 headers as ea02487e/typecheck-normalized.txt lines 1-13 (matched by reading, since the 3f47ced3 root records no explicit equivalence command). Honest limits of this read-only pass: the toolset had no shell or hashing, so manifest SHA-256 lines, commit signatures, pushed refs and the 21-path diff digest 0a215e34 were not recomputed; they rest on the recorded validation.json files and README custody statements. The e8e7b027 README references a final-review root that is absent from the checkout (P2 above).
